name: ASBO Matrix
description: All Star bulk quantity pricing matrix for normal WooCommerce product templates.
changelog:
0.1.2

  • Fixes compatibility with WooCommerce Add to Cart + Options (Beta) and Product Quantity (Beta) blocks by attaching ASBO metadata to Store API add-to-cart requests.
  • Syncs the Matrix active-tier indicator with WooCommerce's beta quantity input.
  • Preserves the selected Embroidery/Patch method for Store API requests.
  • Products without a valid ASBO matrix remain native WooCommerce products and receive no ASBO pricing changes.
